annotation.title_clean: Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in Generative AI
annotation.title_en: Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in Generative AI
named_instruments_referenced: PDPC Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in AI Recommendation and Decision Systems
PDPC Advisory Guidelines on Key Concepts in the PDPA
annotation.summary_en: Singapore PDPC advisory guidelines (July 2026) clarifying how the PDPA applies to personal data across the generative AI lifecycle: web-scraping under the Publicly Available Exception and digital barriers, consent and AI-specific notification, responsibilities of model providers, system providers and deployers, and handling access and correction requests.
key_provisions_or_claims: Publicly accessible online personal data may be scraped for GenAI training under the Publicly Available Exception, subject to reasonableness
Data behind digital barriers (paywalls, registration, bot blockers) requires case-by-case assessment of public availability
AI-specific notification required when using user data for model training; consent cannot be a condition beyond what is reasonable
Allocates data protection obligations among model providers, system providers and system deployers
Best practices for access and correction requests including data provenance, removal from training sets and output filters
